sections.shortTitle: Sindh Development Authorities Laws Revival and Amending Ordinance 2007
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 2007
ORDINANCE VII OF 2007
SINDH DEVELOPMENT
AUTHORITIES LAWS
(REVIVAL AND
AMENDING) ORDINANCE, 2007
An Ordinance to revive
and amend the certain laws
relating to the Development Authorities in the
Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part I,
4th May, 2007]
No.S. Legis. 1(7)/2007, dated 4-5-2007.---The
following Ordinance made by The Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.--Whereas in order to
give impetuous and encourage the housing
industry and provide shelter to the people of the Province, it is expedient to
revive and amend the laws relating to the Malir
Development Authority Act, 1993 and Lyari Development
Authority Act, 1993;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor of Sindh is satisfied
that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of Sindh is pleased
to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Development Authorities Laws (Revival and Amending)
Ordinance, 2007.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 1sl
May, 2007.

3. Saving.---All orders made,
proceedings taken, appointments made, and done by any authority, or by any
person, which were made, taken or done, or purported to have been made, taken
or done between the first day of July, two thousand and two, and the date on
which this Ordinance comes into force (both days inclusive), shall
notwithstanding any judgment of any court be deemed to be and always to have
been validly made, taken or done under the said laws and shall not be called in
question in any court or forum on any ground whatsoever.

The Lyari Development
Authority Act, 1993 (Sindh Act No.X of 1994).
1. Through out the
Act, for the words "Karachi Division", the words "District
Karachi", for the
words "Local Council", the words
"Zila Council", for
the words "Deputy Commissioner", the words "District Officer
Revenue" shall be substituted. 2. In section 2. (a) after clause (f),
the following new clause shall be inserted: "(ff) "consolidation of
land" means adjustment of plots in a scheme by way of exchange or
otherwise for the purpose of the scheme;"; (b) after clause (h), the
following new clause shall be inserted:- "(hh) "District" means
a district defined by the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001;"; (c)
after clause (k), the following new clause shall be inserted:- "(kk)
"Local Government" means the City District Government or, as the
case may be Zila Council;"; (d) in clause (r), the semi-colon shall be
replaced by a full stop; and (e) clause (s) shall be omitted. 3. In section
3, in subsection (3), the words "or such other place as Government may
fix by notification" shall be omitted. 4. For section 4, the following
shall be substituted:- "4.(1) The Authority shall consist of--- (a)
Chairman (b) Director-General Member (c) Four persons to be nominated by
Government as Members. (d) Two persons to be nominated by the Chairman from
amongst the Nazims of the concerned Town Councils as Members. (2) Government
shall appoint City District Nazim as Chairman. 5. In section 5, for the word
"Non-official" the word "The" shall be substituted. 6. In
section 6, for subsection (1), the following shall be substituted:- "6(1). The Director-General shall be appointed by
Government on such terms and conditions as Government may determine.". 7. In section 8, in subsection (1), after clause
(iii), the following new clause shall be inserted:-
"(iii-a) consolidate any land in such manner as may be prescribed by
rules;". 8. In section 28, in
sub-section (2), for the words "in accordance with the provisions
relating to acquisition of land under the Hyderabad Development Authority
Act, 1976" the words "by the Authority" shall be substituted.
9. For the Schedule, the new Schedule as in Appendix "A" shall be
substituted.
